prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the chellow, an alien squat flying animal shaped like a near-spherical ball of dense, short, downy plumage in cool slate-blue and dusky teal with pale silvery feather edging. The neck is very short and the head sits low, nestled into the shoulder feathers. Two very short, thin legs with two toes are set far under the round body, so the body rests low to the ground. A pair of small wings is folded neatly against its sides, symmetric and clearly readable, the feather tips reaching toward a tiny tucked tail. The head is entirely bare: wrinkled pink skin with no feathers at all, with a smooth, rounded, blunt facial contour. The face ends flat: below the eyes is a short, broad, soft membrane of wrinkled skin stretched across the mouth area like a drum-skin, continuous with the skin of the head. The mouth is a broad, flexible, lipless flap of skin lying flat against that blunt face, softly rippled as it vibrates to whistle. Below the head hangs a wide, thin, translucent throat-fan it inflates to carry the call, veined and lit faintly from behind, spreading over the chest and joined to the head and chest as part of one body. Front view: eyes toward the viewer, the flat drum-skin face, the throat-fan hanging below the chin, both folded wings visible at the sides. Side view: one folded wing along the flank, the bare head in profile with a smooth rounded blunt face and the skin flap lying flat against it, the throat-fan hanging below, the tail behind. Rear view, seen from behind: the folded wings, the plumage of the back and tail, and the bare wrinkled head from behind with the eyes hidden. Painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, realistic, with a clean dark outline and soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
